_comment: Parked-car layouts for the CIR-Generator's Sionna Ray Tracing model
('Parked cars' -> 'Layout presets'). Selecting several presets merges
them left to right, so a wide table can be laid down first and a few
road classes corrected on top of it.
A kerb now carries two numbers, because they answer two questions and
multiplying them into one is what used to line every arterial in a
render with cars:
'class_permission' -- P(a car may stand on this kerb at all), keyed
by the OSM highway=* value. Measured, not guessed: OSM's
parking:left/right/both schema states it per side, and the centre of
Kazan gives service 0.58, residential 0.38, unclassified 0.18,
tertiary 0.14, primary 0.08, secondary 0.03, links 0.00. A way that
carries the tag itself overrides this entirely.
'class_density' -- how full an allowed kerb is. Near one in a city
centre; this is the half the live 'density' slider multiplies.
'orientation_mix' is P(parallel / perpendicular / diagonal) on an
allowed kerb, again overridden by the way's own
parking:<side>:orientation. Courtyards park in bays, streets park in a
line, and a bay is four times the metal per metre of kerb.
The key '*' applies to every class in that table and is overridden by
an explicit entry. The live knobs (global density, both-sides
probability, seed, car cap, device clearance and the drawn zones) come
from the widgets and win over whatever a preset says.
The FIRST preset is what an empty selection falls back to, so it has to
be the one that places no cars.
Cars only exist on scenes built by pages/osm_scene, or on any scene
whose streets can be read off its geometry: the road centrelines come
from the scene's _osm.json sidecar or from derive_roads, and nothing
in a written Mitsuba scene can say where a street is.

presets.name: no_cars
presets.label: No parked cars
presets.description: Leaves the streets empty -- the scene as it was built.

presets.name: city_centre
presets.label: City centre (OSM-measured kerbside parking)
presets.description: The default picture: courtyards and side streets nearly full, arterials all but empty, because that is what the city's own parking tags say.

presets.name: residential_night
presets.label: Residential, night (courtyards saturated)
presets.description: Everyone is home: every kerb that allows parking is full and more of them are parked on both sides. Through roads stay as empty as the daytime.

presets.name: sparse
presets.label: Sparse (a few cars per street)
presets.description: An out-of-hours or suburban picture -- enough metal to matter, far from a continuous wall.

presets.name: courtyards_only
presets.label: Courtyards only (service ways)
presets.description: Cars in the yards behind the blocks and nowhere on the street grid. The courtyard aisle is two thirds of the vehicle ways in a Russian city centre and where most of the real cars stand.

presets.name: bays
presets.label: Perpendicular bays
presets.description: Correction layer: parks in bays rather than a line wherever the street is wide enough to hold one. Four times the metal per metre of kerb, and broadside to the street.

presets.name: parallel_only
presets.label: Parallel rows only
presets.description: Correction layer: no bays anywhere, whatever the class or the OSM tag would have drawn.

presets.name: at_the_kerb
presets.label: At the kerb, not against the wall
presets.description: Correction layer: keeps the row at the edge of the carriageway instead of crossing the pavement to the facade. The older placement, kept for an ablation against it.

presets.name: ignore_osm_parking
presets.label: Ignore the OSM parking tags
presets.description: Correction layer: decide every kerb from the class prior alone, even where the way states its own restriction. For a scene whose tags are sparse, or to ablate against them.

presets.name: one_side_only
presets.label: One side only (alternate-side rule)
presets.description: Never both kerbs of the same street; which side is drawn per way from the seed. Ways that state their own parking still follow what they state.

presets.name: both_sides_always
presets.label: Both sides always
presets.description: Every street that allows parking carries it on both kerbs.

presets.name: arterials_too
presets.label: Include arterials and trunk roads
presets.description: Adds kerbside parking to the classes that normally have none. Correction layer -- select it after a base preset, and note it is contrary to what the city's own tags say.

presets.name: no_bridges
presets.label: Skip bridges and tunnels
presets.description: Correction layer: keeps cars off decks and out of tunnels, where a kerb usually does not exist.
